text: {"action": null, "answer": "Project Zenith is a cloud storage optimization initiative launched in Q3 2023, led by Marcus Cole, with a kickoff meeting on July 15th. The project aims to enhance security, accessibility, and data visualization using AI. Key phases include design, development (led by Omar Jensen), and phase two, which achieved a breakthrough in predictive analytics. The initial budget was approved at $2M, with specific allocations for compliance ($55k) and training ($15k), though an overall budget adjustment was made to $550k due to unforeseen expenses. Feedback on the prototype is being sought by the end of November, and a detailed progress report will be presented on November 20th."}
